The '''Plympto system''' was a minor [[Star system/Legends|star system]] along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The system's [[Star/Legends|star]] was named [[Plympto/Legends|Plympto]]. The [[New Plympto system/Legends|New Plympto system]] was named for Plympto.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
